verdict.rationale: Capsule's own docs say users can filter contact lists by a custom field they have added, and can filter opportunities by status, tag and milestone. That covers custom fields and filtered views. Sorting, sharing views with the team, and adding fields without admin involvement are not evidenced. missing for 10: sorted views, shared or saved views, an explicit custom-field creation workflow, confirmation that no admin is required, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: Manage contacts in lists by filtering using your own or using a custom field you have added.
Filter opportunities based on status, tag, milestone and more.
